Storage: ext4 loop image on host-shared storage; nodev,nosuid,noexec
Network: Direct virtual LAN between separate Windows and Linux VMs; no SSH tunnel
Sender: Windows 11 ARM64 VM; 4 vCPUs; 4 GiB RAM; C: only
ReceiverBinding: Private virtual-LAN interface; restricted to collector address; fresh per-run account/key
Timings: Collector: Windows Stopwatch process launch through exit. Verified finish: local collector completion or SFTP receiver process completion measured from sender-start marker on Linux monotonic clock (approximately 0.2 second observation resolution). Receiver readback timing begins at readback status line. Additional independent local VHDX verification excluded.
Size: Final output file lengths / allocated bytes, excluding harness logs. SFTP includes compressed incoming objects, journal, receiver metadata and receipt; no restored second payload copy.
